purpose: Provisional engineering criteria recorded before the pilot model outputs are reviewed. Passing is not fan approval or statistical evidence of broad superiority.

training.interpretation: Initial budget only. Diagnose mask, updates, small-set adaptation and generalization separately before attributing failure.

quality.unit: Each character and facts-off/on condition; report raw numerators and denominators.
quality.allowedLoreMeaning: Some cases supply the answer in known_context; this is not closed-book lore recall.

adapterSelection.rule: Report all wins/ties/losses. Prefer adapter only with a clear measured benefit and no material context/fact regression; retain base otherwise. If neither meets quality criteria, any default remains an experimental candidate.

latency.executor: one process, one loaded model, serial FIFO, fresh per-request KV cache

finalSet: Remain sealed during development and model selection. Do not count development cases as held-out final results.
productDecision: Local execution, learning effect, fan style quality and public application integration are separate outcomes.
